headline: Huge impairment hides steady underlying margins
summary_short: Concentrix Q3 revenue was $2,453.7M (-1.2% y/y) and non-GAAP EPS $2.92 (+5.0%), while a $1,050M goodwill impairment drove a GAAP loss of $16.24 per share.
summary_long: Revenue slipped 1.2% y/y (-0.5% in constant currency). Non-GAAP operating margin rose 30bp to 12.6% and adjusted EBITDA was $363.0M. A non-cash goodwill impairment of $1,050M, tied to the stock's trading range and market cap, caused a net loss of $988.1M. Operating cash flow was $268.2M and adjusted free cash flow $218.3M. No shares were repurchased; the dividend rises to $0.37 from $0.36. Full-year non-GAAP EPS guidance is $10.97 to $11.09.
confidence_notes: GAAP net income and EPS are not comparable y/y (change over 100%, marked NM by the company) because of the goodwill impairment, so no delta is given. The shard's EPS KPI of 2.92 is the Yahoo non-GAAP figure, matching the release; its q/q reference is GAAP basic EPS, so no q/q delta is shown. Non-GAAP measures are company-defined.

drivers.explanation: Declines in technology and consumer electronics (-10%), healthcare (-17%) and communications and media (-7%), partly offset by retail, travel and e-commerce (+6%) and banking and financial services (+12%).
A non-cash goodwill impairment of $1,050.0M, primarily resulting from the recent trading range of the stock price and market capitalization.
Non-GAAP operating margin expanded 30bp to 12.6%; the release does not give a detailed cause beyond management citing margin expansion and growth of new services.
Management says half of revenue now comes from business won in the last three years, while it disrupts its own traditional business.
